examples.title: Example 1: Implementing Modal Transition Using bindContentCover
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to implement a modal transition using the bindContentCover API.

examples.title: Example 2: Implementing a Custom Transition Animation
examples.description: This example applies a custom animation to two modals whose transition type is none.

examples.title: Example 3: Implementing a Slide-up and Slide-down Transition Animation
examples.description: This example shows two modals whose transition type is slide-up and slide-down animation.

examples.title: Example 4: Implementing an Opacity Transition Animation
examples.description: This example shows two modals whose transition type is opacity animation.

examples.title: Example 5: Implementing Custom Transitions with Different Effects
examples.description: This example demonstrates custom transitions for modals, including rotation and translation effects.

examples.title: Example 6: Setting a Full-Screen Modal to Adapt to the Safe Area
examples.description: Starting from API version 20, this example demonstrates the content effect when enableSafeArea is set to true to adapt the full-screen modal to the safe area. The background color of the full-screen modal is light blue, the content color is gray, and the content is laid out in the safe area.
